envelope.description: The item measurer returns content and reports unconfirmed items as not covered

body.title: The item measurer returns content and reports unconfirmed items as not covered
body.summary: Make createItemMeasurer's measure(entity) in src/analyze/explore/item-measure.ts return the content with the length, and make partlyRead produce a skipped or partlyRead entry in Story s1's completeness record for an item whose content could not be confirmed, so the analyzer never presents such an item as read.
acceptanceChecks: measure(entity) returns content for a confirmed item and none for an unconfirmed one
An unconfirmed item produces a skipped or partlyRead entry with the reason and is not reported as read

tests.name: partly-read.test.ts: measure returns content for a confirmed item and a skipped or partlyRead entry with its reason for an unconfirmed one
